findings: Q1601 gate and U1601 GATE are joined to the existing clamp/RC group. Q1602 gate remains separate.
C1602 moved 1.35 mm down; R1601 moved 2.4 mm right, retaining its original orientation. R1701 and R1707 are placed as a horizontal pair with short pin approaches.
Sampling escape follows the actual rounded pad before turning; no new same-face nominal body intersection remains.
Obsolete inner gate branch and two obsolete non-ground transfers removed; two new transfers installed. No ground via moved.
Inner gate branch stays above the CAM distribution region. All 50 power-width and 155 ground-pad checks remain valid.
Native owner BODY guards follow the explicit part transforms; R1601 retains the unchanged global via cutouts. No rules, exclusions or unrelated keepouts are relaxed.
